'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2021 Apure clashes]]
**Venezuelan [[intelligence official]]s announce the death of Hernán Darío Hernández, the leader of a [[FARC dissidents|FARC dissident]] group, after an [[ambush]] carried out by a [[commando]] of the [[Venezuelan Armed Forces]]. Hernández was responsible for the [[2003 El Nogal Club bombing]] that killed 36 people and injured over 200 others. [https://www.eltiempo.com/justicia/conflicto-y-narcotrafico/el-paisa-muerto-en-venezuela-637055 (''El Tiempo'')] 
*[[Mali War]]
** Militants bomb two [[United Nations|UN camps]] in [[Gao]], with no fatalities. [https://www.voanews.com/a/explosions-rock-un-camps-in-mali/6340413.html (Voice of America)]
*[[2021 Niger attacks]]
**Hundreds of [[insurgent]]s on motorcycles attack an international [[military base]] in [[Tillabéri]]. Seventy-nine of the rebels and 29 soldiers are killed during the battle. [https://www.dw.com/en/west-africa-explosions-attacks-in-mali-niger-kill-over-100/a-60025843 (Deutsche Welle)]
*[[2021 Nagaland killings]]
**[[Indian Army|Indian soldiers]] of the [[Assam Rifles]] mistakenly open fire on a group of [[mining in India|miners]] returning home from work in [[Nagaland]], believing them to be [[Insurgency in Northeast India|militants]]. Thirteen miners and a soldier are killed, with the soldier and seven miners being killed in a subsequent confrontation with angry locals. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-59531445 (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2021 Semeru eruption]]
**The death toll from yesterday's eruption of the [[Semeru]] [[volcano]] in [[East Java]], [[Indonesia]], increases to 14, with 56 others injured. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-59532251 (BBC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Australia]]
***The [[Therapeutic Goods Administration]] provisionally approves the usage of the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine]] for children between the ages of 5 and 11 years. [[Vaccination]] rollout for this age group will begin on January 10, once [[Australian Technical Advisory Group on Immunisation|ATAGI]] gives its recommendation. [https://www.theguardian.com/society/2021/dec/05/australian-children-aged-five-to-11-set-to-receive-pfizer-covid-vaccine-from-mid-january (''The Guardian'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Maldives]]
***[[Maldives]] reports its first case of the [[SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant]] in a tourist that arrived in the country. [https://raajje.mv/110489 (''Raajje'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Saudi Arabia]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Saudi Arabia]]
***[[Saudi Arabia]] grants the approval for people vaccinated with [[Russia]]'s [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine]] to enter the country beginning from January 1, 2022 in a move that will enable [[Muslim]]s to take part in religious [[pilgrimage]]. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/world/saudi-arabia-approves-entry-tourists-jabbed-sputnik-covid-19-vaccine-2359811 (CNA)] 
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Senegal]]
***[[Senegal]] reports its first case of the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron variant in a 58-year-old man who attended an international meeting in [[Dakar]] with 300 people from different countries on November 24 and 25. [https://www.khaleejtimes.com/coronavirus/senegal-detects-first-case-of-covid-omicron-variant (''Khaleej Times'')]
